title: Tiny, cute tractor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='40' ry='6' fill='#1a2340'/>
  <!-- rear big wheel -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='66' r='18' fill='#2c2c2c'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='66' r='18' fill='none' stroke='#4a4a4a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='66' r='11' fill='#f5c518'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='66' r='4' fill='#c99a0a'/>
  <!-- rear wheel treads -->
  <g stroke='#555555' stroke-width='3'>
    <line x1='32' y1='49' x2='32' y2='83'/>
    <line x1='15' y1='66' x2='49' y2='66'/>
    <line x1='20' y1='54' x2='44' y2='78'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='54' x2='20' y2='78'/>
  </g>
  <!-- front small wheel -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='76' r='11' fill='#2c2c2c'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='76' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#4a4a4a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='76' r='6' fill='#f5c518'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#c99a0a'/>
  <!-- axle -->
  <rect x='44' y='72' width='30' height='6' rx='3' fill='#8a1f1f'/>
  <!-- tractor body -->
  <rect x='30' y='44' width='48' height='24' rx='5' fill='#e63946'/>
  <rect x='30' y='44' width='48' height='7' rx='4' fill='#ff6b76'/>
  <!-- engine hood -->
  <rect x='62' y='40' width='18' height='16' rx='4' fill='#c1121f'/>
  <rect x='62' y='40' width='18' height='5' rx='3' fill='#ff6b76'/>
  <!-- grille -->
  <rect x='76' y='44' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <line x1='77.5' y1='44' x2='77.5' y2='54' stroke='#c1121f' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x='67' y='28' width='5' height='14' rx='2' fill='#555555'/>
  <rect x='66' y='26' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#777777'/>
  <!-- cabin -->
  <rect x='38' y='16' width='26' height='30' rx='4' fill='#f1a208'/>
  <rect x='38' y='16' width='26' height='5' rx='2' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='43' y='22' width='16' height='16' rx='3' fill='#a8e6ff'/>
  <rect x='43' y='22' width='16' height='5' rx='2' fill='#dff6ff'/>
  <!-- cabin roof -->
  <rect x='36' y='12' width='30' height='6' rx='3' fill='#c1121f'/>
  <rect x='36' y='12' width='30' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#ff6b76'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='81' cy='47' r='3.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='47' r='1.5' fill='#fff7cc'/>
  <!-- little cloud of puff -->
  <circle cx='69' cy='22' r='3' fill='#c9d6ff'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='19' r='2.5' fill='#c9d6ff'/>
</svg>
